description: BLL + SL layers. Build the Repository + Unit-of-Work surface (IGenericRepo<T>/GenericRepo<T>, per-entity I<Entity>Repo/<Entity>Repo with the MANDATORY entity-specific methods, IRepoWrapper/RepoWrapper with lazy per-entity init and sync void Save()), the ApiResponse<T> wrapper, the PasswordHasherService, and the SL JWT TokenManager (ITokenService/TokenService). Depends on FEAT-001 (needs Shop.DAL Models/ViewModels/ShopContext). Ground every type in design.md §2.6, §2.7, §2.8, §2.8a and the step-prompt repository-surface clarification.
steps: Create src/Shop.BLL/IRepositories/IGenericRepo.cs: IGenericRepo<T> where T:class with `IQueryable<T> Query();` (deferred for paging/filtering), `Task<List<T>> GetAllAsync();`, `Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(int id);`, `void Add(T entity);`, `void Update(T entity);`, `void Delete(T entity);`. XML-doc each member.

Create src/Shop.BLL/Repositories/GenericRepo.cs: GenericRepo<T> where T:class with `protected readonly ShopContext _context;` implementing against _context.Set<T>(). Add an inline // comment on why Query() returns IQueryable (deferred execution for pagination). XML-doc.

Create per-entity interfaces in src/Shop.BLL/IRepositories/ and classes in src/Shop.BLL/Repositories/ (prefix I, suffix Repo) for: Product, Category, Order, Customer, Discount, InventoryItem, AdminUser, Role, Cart. Each interface extends IGenericRepo<TEntity>; each class extends GenericRepo<TEntity> and implements the interface with ctor `(ShopContext context) : base(context)`.

Add the MANDATORY entity-specific methods (step-prompt clarification 2): IProductRepo.GetPagedAsync(int page,int pageSize,int? categoryId) returning `Task<(List<Product> Items, int TotalCount)>` — build IQueryable, apply optional categoryId filter, capture TotalCount via CountAsync() BEFORE Skip/Take, then materialize; add an inline // comment that returning TotalCount is what enables preserved-position pagination. IProductRepo.GetByIdsAsync(IEnumerable<int> ids) -> Task<List<Product>> (bulk load). IAdminUserRepo.GetByUsernameAsync(string username) -> Task<AdminUser?> (Include Role). IOrderRepo.GetByOrderNumberAsync(string orderNumber) -> Task<Order?> (Include OrderItems). IDiscountRepo.GetByCodeAsync(string code) -> Task<Discount?>. NO out/ref parameters on any async method.

Create src/Shop.BLL/IRepositories/IRepoWrapper.cs exposing properties named _Product, _Category, _Order, _Customer, _Discount, _InventoryItem, _AdminUser, _Role, _Cart (each of the matching I<Entity>Repo type) and `void Save();`. _Cart is kept for structural symmetry (unused by current endpoints). XML-doc.

Create src/Shop.BLL/Repositories/RepoWrapper.cs: RepoWrapper : IRepoWrapper holding `private readonly ShopContext _context;` and one nullable backing field per repo; each property lazily news-up its repo via `??=` with an inline // comment explaining lazy init (create on first access, reuse for the unit-of-work lifetime). Save() calls `_context.SaveChanges();` with an inline // comment: single commit point for the UoW. XML-doc.

Create src/Shop.BLL/Response_VM/ApiResponse.cs: ApiResponse<T> { bool Success; string? Message; T? Data; int StatusCode; } with static `Ok(T data, string? msg=null)` and `Fail(string msg, int statusCode)` factory methods. XML-doc.

Create src/Shop.BLL/Security/IPasswordHasherService.cs (Hash(string)->string, Verify(string storedHash,string providedPassword)->bool) and PasswordHasherService.cs wrapping a shared PasswordHasher<AdminUser> constructed with explicit PasswordHasherOptions (CompatibilityMode=IdentityV3) so the seeded constant stays reproducible (NIT-3). Hash calls HashPassword(null!, password); Verify returns result != PasswordVerificationResult.Failed (Success or SuccessRehashNeeded). XML-doc.
Create src/Shop.SL/TokenManager/ITokenService.cs: `TokenVM GenerateToken(AdminUser user);` (TokenVM from Shop.DAL.ViewModels). XML-doc.

Create src/Shop.SL/TokenManager/TokenService.cs: reads Jwt:SecretKey/Issuer/Audience/ExpiryMinutes from IConfiguration, builds claims (sub=username, role=role name, nameid=id), signs with HmacSha256 over a SymmetricSecurityKey, returns TokenVM{Token,Expires}. Add inline // comments on claim choice and signing. XML-doc.
acceptance_criteria: IGenericRepo<T>/GenericRepo<T> expose Query()/GetAllAsync()/GetByIdAsync(int)/Add/Update/Delete exactly as specified; reads async, writes sync.

Per-entity repos exist for all 9 entities with I prefix + Repo suffix; the four mandated entity-specific methods and GetPagedAsync (tuple return, no out/ref) are present on the correct interfaces and implementations.
IRepoWrapper exposes _<Entity> properties for all 9 entities + void Save(); RepoWrapper lazily inits each repo with ??= and Save() calls SaveChanges() once, with the required inline comments.

ApiResponse<T> has Ok/Fail factories; PasswordHasherService wraps PasswordHasher<AdminUser> with explicit IdentityV3 options; TokenService returns a signed TokenVM from the Jwt config section with inline comments on claims/signing.
verification: Run `dotnet build Shop.sln` from repo root and confirm 0 errors.
Confirm RepoWrapper uses lazy ??= init and sync void Save() (read the file).
findings:
Build verified: `dotnet build Shop.sln` => Build succeeded, 0 Warnings, 0 Errors (EXITCODE=0), no live DB. All 4 projects compile. Shell echoes command artifacts; build result was captured to a temp log file (since removed) and read back to confirm the real 0/0 result.

SHOP.BLL REPOSITORY SURFACE (namespaces Shop.BLL.IRepositories / Shop.BLL.Repositories):
- IGenericRepo<T> where T:class : IQueryable<T> Query(); Task<List<T>> GetAllAsync(); Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(int id); void Add/Update/Delete(T). GenericRepo<T> implements via `protected readonly ShopContext _context;` against _context.Set<T>(). GetByIdAsync uses FindAsync(id).AsTask(). Query() returns _context.Set<T>() with inline comment on deferred execution for pagination.
- Per-entity (I-prefix, Repo-suffix) for all 9: Product, Category, Order, Customer, Discount, InventoryItem, AdminUser, Role, Cart. Each class ctor `(ShopContext context) : base(context)`.
- MANDATORY entity-specific methods implemented: IProductRepo.GetPagedAsync(int page,int pageSize,int? categoryId) => Task<(List<Product> Items,int TotalCount)>; CountAsync() BEFORE Skip/Take, Includes Images+Variants, OrderBy(p=>p.Id), NO out/ref. IProductRepo.GetByIdsAsync(IEnumerable<int> ids) => Task<List<Product>> via Where(ids.Contains). IAdminUserRepo.GetByUsernameAsync(string) => Include(a=>a.Role).FirstOrDefaultAsync. IOrderRepo.GetByOrderNumberAsync(string) => Include(o=>o.Items).FirstOrDefaultAsync (NOTE: Order's line-items nav property is `Items`, NOT `OrderItems`). IDiscountRepo.GetByCodeAsync(string) => FirstOrDefaultAsync(d=>d.Code==code).

UNIT OF WORK: IRepoWrapper exposes properties _Product,_Category,_Order,_Customer,_Discount,_InventoryItem,_AdminUser,_Role,_Cart (each the matching I<Entity>Repo) + void Save(). RepoWrapper : IRepoWrapper holds `private readonly ShopContext _context;` + one nullable backing field per repo; each property lazy-inits via `??= new <Entity>Repo(_context)` (inline comment present). Save() => _context.SaveChanges() once (inline single-commit-point comment present). _Cart kept for symmetry, unused by endpoints.

ApiResponse<T> (Shop.BLL.Response_VM): { bool Success; string? Message; T? Data; int StatusCode; } with static Ok(T data,string? msg=null) => Success=true,StatusCode=200 and Fail(string msg,int statusCode) => Success=false,Data=default.

PASSWORD HASHER (Shop.BLL.Security): IPasswordHasherService { string Hash(string); bool Verify(string storedHash,string providedPassword); }. PasswordHasherService wraps a single PasswordHasher<AdminUser> constructed with Options.Create(new PasswordHasherOptions{ CompatibilityMode = PasswordHasherCompatibilityMode.IdentityV3 }). Hash => HashPassword(null!,password). Verify => VerifyHashedPassword(null!,storedHash,providedPassword) != PasswordVerificationResult.Failed (Success or SuccessRehashNeeded both pass). This matches the FEAT-001 seeded IdentityV3 hash for admin/'Admin@12345'.

SL TOKEN MANAGER (Shop.SL.TokenManager): ITokenService { TokenVM GenerateToken(AdminUser user); } (TokenVM from Shop.DAL.ViewModels, fields Token+Expires). TokenService ctor(IConfiguration). Reads Jwt:SecretKey/Issuer/Audience/ExpiryMinutes (ExpiryMinutes defaults 120 if absent). Claims: JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub=username, ClaimTypes.Role=Role?.Name, JwtRegisteredClaimNames.NameId=id (inline comment on claim choice). Signs via SymmetricSecurityKey(UTF8 secret) + SigningCredentials HmacSha256 (inline comment on signing). Returns TokenVM{Token=WriteToken(jwt), Expires=UtcNow+ExpiryMinutes}.

NOT WIRED YET: no DI registrations added to Program.cs (IRepoWrapper/ITokenService/IPasswordHasherService/JWT auth land in FEAT-003 per plan). No AutoMapper/controllers here. Shop.BLL already referenced Microsoft.Extensions.Identity.Core 7.0.20 (FEAT-001); Shop.SL already referenced System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 7.0.3 + Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 7.0.3 — no package changes needed in this feature.
